passages.text: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, along with the altar and all its utensils.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
He finished setting up the tabernacle.
He anointed the tabernacle.
He consecrated the tabernacle.
He anointed all the tabernacle’s furnishings.
He consecrated all the tabernacle’s furnishings.
He anointed the altar.
He consecrated the altar.
He anointed all the altar’s utensils.
He consecrated all the altar’s utensils.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֡י בְּיוֹם֩ כַּלּ֨וֹת מֹשֶׁ֜ה לְהָקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֹת֜וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵ֖ם וַיְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: And the leaders of Israel, the heads of their families, presented an offering. These men were the tribal leaders who had supervised the registration.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel brought an offering.
These leaders were the heads of their families.
They were also the leaders of the tribes.
They had supervised the registration of the people.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם הֵ֚ם נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַמַּטֹּ֔ת הֵ֥ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִֽים׃

passages.text: They brought as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two leaders—and presented them before the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel brought an offering to the LORD.
These leaders were the heads of their tribes.
They brought six covered carts.
They also brought twelve oxen.
Every two leaders brought one cart.
Each leader brought one ox.
They presented these offerings before the tabernacle.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ קָרְבָּנָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־ עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּשְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר עֲגָלָ֛ה עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וֹר לְאֶחָ֑ד וַיַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אוֹתָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “Take these gifts from the leaders of Israel.
Use these gifts for the work of the Tent of Meeting.
Give the gifts to the Levites.
Give each Levite what he needs for his work.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ קַ֚ח מֵֽאִתָּ֔ם וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִ֥י עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took the carts.
Moses took the oxen.
Moses gave the carts and oxen to the Levites.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ הָעֲגָלֹ֖ת וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֑ר וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required, and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
passages.sermon:
Moses gave gifts to the Levites.
The Levites served in the Tent of Meeting.
Moses gave two carts to the Gershonites.
He gave four oxen to the Gershonites.
The Gershonites received these because of their work.
Moses gave four carts to the Merarites.
He gave eight oxen to the Merarites.
The Merarites received these because of their work.
Ithamar directed the Merarites.
Ithamar was the son of Aaron the priest.
passages.original: אֵ֣ת׀ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ אַרְבַּ֣עַת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן כְּפִ֖י עֲבֹדָתָֽם׃ וְאֵ֣ת׀ אַרְבַּ֣ע הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י כְּפִי֙ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
passages.sermon:
Moses did not give any carts or oxen to the Kohathites.
The Kohathites had a special duty.
They carried the holy objects.
They carried these objects on their shoulders.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לֹ֣א נָתָ֑ן כִּֽי־ עֲבֹדַ֤ת הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם בַּכָּתֵ֖ף יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃

passages.text: When the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel brought offerings.
They brought these offerings for the dedication of the altar.
This happened on the day the altar was anointed.
The leaders presented their offerings in front of the altar.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ הַנְּשִׂאִ֗ים אֵ֚ת חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּקְרִ֧יבוּ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֛ם אֶת־ קָרְבָּנָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Each day, one leader must bring an offering.
Each leader brings his offering for the dedication of the altar.
The leaders present their offerings one at a time, each on a different day.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד לַיּ֗וֹם נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לַיּ֔וֹם יַקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ אֶת־ קָרְבָּנָ֔ם לַחֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ס

passages.text: On the first day Nahshon son of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah drew near with his offering.
passages.sermon:
Nahshon was the son of Amminadab.
Nahshon belonged to the tribe of Judah.
On the first day, Nahshon brought his offering.
Nahshon approached with his offering.

passages.text: His offering was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering; one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense; one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering; one male goat for a sin offering; and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.

This was the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
passages.sermon:
Ahiezer was the leader of the tribe of Dan.
Ahiezer was the son of Ammishaddai.
Ahiezer brought an offering.
He gave one silver platter.
The silver platter weighed one hundred and thirty shekels.
He gave one silver bowl.
The silver bowl weighed seventy shekels.
Both the platter and the bowl were measured by the sanctuary shekel.
Both the platter and the bowl were filled with fine flour.
The fine flour was mixed with oil.
This was for a grain offering.
He gave one gold dish.
The gold dish weighed ten shekels.
The gold dish was filled with incense.
He gave one young bull.
He gave one ram.
He gave one male lamb.
The male lamb was one year old.
These were for a burnt offering.
He gave one male goat.
The male goat was for a sin offering.
He gave two oxen for a peace offering.
He gave five rams for a peace offering.
He gave five male goats for a peace offering.
He gave five male lambs.
The male lambs were one year old.
This was the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

passages.text: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel brought offerings.
They gave these offerings for the dedication of the altar.
The altar was anointed on that day.
They brought twelve silver platters.
They brought twelve silver bowls.
They brought twelve gold dishes.
passages.original: זֹ֣את׀ חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל קַעֲרֹ֨ת כֶּ֜סֶף שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֗ה מִֽזְרְקֵי־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ר כַּפּ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

passages.text: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each silver bowl seventy shekels. The total weight of the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
passages.sermon:
Each silver platter weighed one hundred thirty shekels.
Each silver bowl weighed seventy shekels.
The total weight of all the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels.
They used the sanctuary shekel for this measurement.
passages.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֗ה הַקְּעָרָ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים הַמִּזְרָ֣ק הָאֶחָ֑ד כֹּ֚ל כֶּ֣סֶף הַכֵּלִ֔ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel brought offerings for the dedication of the altar.
They brought twelve gold dishes.
Each gold dish was filled with incense.
Each gold dish weighed ten shekels.
They used the sanctuary shekel to measure the weight.
The total weight of all the gold dishes was one hundred and twenty shekels.
passages.original: כַּפּ֨וֹת זָהָ֤ב שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מְלֵאֹ֣ת קְטֹ֔רֶת עֲשָׂרָ֧ה עֲשָׂרָ֛ה הַכַּ֖ף בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כָּל־ זְהַ֥ב הַכַּפּ֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּמֵאָֽה׃

passages.text: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs a year old—together with their grain offerings—and twelve male goats for the sin offering.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites brought animals for offerings to God.
They brought twelve bulls for the burnt offering.
They brought twelve rams for the burnt offering.
They brought twelve male lambs.
Each lamb was one year old.
They brought grain offerings with these animals.
They brought twelve male goats for the sin offering.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם וּשְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites brought animals for the peace offering.
They sacrificed twenty-four bulls.
They sacrificed sixty rams.
They sacrificed sixty male goats.
They sacrificed sixty male lambs that were one year old.
These animals were the dedication offering for the altar.
They gave this offering after they anointed the altar.
passages.original: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר׀ זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁים֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֔ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֑ים זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony. Thus the LORD spoke to him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD is God.
The Tent of Meeting was a special place for meeting with God.
Moses entered the Tent of Meeting.
Moses went in to speak with the LORD.
Moses heard a voice speaking to him.
The voice came from above the mercy seat.
The mercy seat was on the ark of the Testimony.
The voice came from between the two cherubim.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
passages.original: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־ הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽיו׃פ
